On this maize plot, I will keep my costs low because money is not easy and we depend mostly on the rains here in Mtwara. I will plant maize with other crops as I usually do, use my own local seed, and rely mainly on family work with the hand hoe. I may put a little manure if I have it, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer, I will not spray, and I will not irrigate.
